_comment: Models GPUEnsemble chooses from, checked by hand. rank is a rough quality order (1 = best) as of 2026-11; edit it or add entries freely. An entry needs id, name, rank, hf_repo and hf_quant; `profile` is optional: without it, `catalog --update` reads the header of the file on Hugging Face (a few MB) and keeps the profile it builds. `pull` downloads the .gguf whose name has hf_quant as a whole word from the hf_repo repository on Hugging Face (all split parts). The app fetches the newest copy of this file from the repository; it uses it when its `updated` date is later than the installed one.
